items.title: Which 3 ETFs Best Fit ExxonMobil After Its Angola Move?
items.summary: If you like ExxonMobil Holdings for its global oil and gas reach, owning only the single stock means your money rises and falls entirely with its own issues. Simply Wall St points out that earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 2.2% a year over the next few years, and the business is still closely tied to long term demand for fossil fuels. items.title: What Does ExxonMobil (XOM) Gain From Its $4 Billion Angola Block 15 Bet?
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) and partners approved a US$4b final investment decision to redevelop Angola’s offshore Block 15. The plan covers further development of existing infrastructure and progresses new hydrocarbon discoveries within the long producing deepwater block. The decision includes funding to support ongoing production commitments in Angola alongside development of recently identified resources in Block 15. items.title: The Home Depot to Present at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference
items.summary: The Home Depot®, the world's largest home improvement retailer, today announced that Richard McPhail, chief executive officer, will present at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference. The presentation will begin at 8:45 a.m. ET on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.
